answers.core: Requires changing how mesh data is used on the GPU.
answers.workaround: Not having this requires you to do a lot of post processing on the CPU (to copy the data into a new buffer with a Vector3 datatype) which negates the point of using a GLSL shader in the first place.  There is no good workaround.
